final, or preliminary while a cruise’s calibrations are not yet applied.
calcofi_ctd-cast on every row.
Date and time (UTC) of the cast. In CalCOFI’s original cast file (Date, Time), the time is when the CTD reached its terminal depth.
Deepest depth of the reading, in metres. The CTD profile is binned to 1 m.
Shallowest depth of the reading, in metres. The CTD profile is binned to 1 m.
CalCOFI station grid cell the cast falls in.
Observed latitude of the cast, in decimal degrees (Lat_Dec in the original cast file).
CalCOFI line number: the first number of site_key, for example 090.0.
Observed longitude of the cast, in decimal degrees (Lon_Dec in the original cast file).

The CTD team’s flag for the reading, as published: 0 good, 1 use the primary sensor, 2 use the secondary sensor, 4 below detection limit (reported as 0), 8 questionable, 9 bad or missing. Blank means 0.

Which CTD quantity the row is, for example temperature_ave, salinity_ave_corr or oxygen_ml_l_ave_cruise_corr. Sensors 1 and 2, their average, cruise- or station-corrected versions, bottle values and sensor-based estimates. Each is described, with its units, in measurement_type.csv.
The reading, in the units given in the units column. Corrected, averaged and estimated quantities are explained in measurement_type.csv.
Row number of the reading. Renumbered with every release, so do not rely on it across releases.
Order in which the station was occupied on the cruise (Order_Occ in the original cast file).
env on every row here: physical and chemical measurements, no organisms.
The cast this reading came from, calcofi_ctd-cast:cast:… Joins sample.csv.
What one row of sample.csv is. In this dataset, a CTD cast.
CalCOFI line and station of the cast, for example 090.0 060.0 (Sta_ID in the original cast file).
CalCOFI station number along the line: the second number of site_key, for example 060.0.
